select * from ( select rownum rn, m.* from ( select p.product_id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.price as price,NVL(s.quantity,0) as quantity, p.unit as unit, i.file_path as image_path,i.save_name as save_name, c.category_path as category_path, p.status as status from product p left join stock s on p.product_id = s.product_id left join product_image i on p.image_id=i.image_id left join ( select category_id, ltrim(sys_connect_by_path(category_name,'>'),'>') as category_path from category start with parent_id is null connect by prior category_id = parent_id) c on p.category_id = c.category_id
(p.product_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or c.category_path like '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
( p.status = #{status} )
order by p.product_id ) m )
where rn >= #{startRow} and rn <= #{endRow}

select count(*) from ( select p.product_id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.price as price,NVL(s.quantity,0) as quantity, p.unit as unit, i.file_path as image_path,i.save_name as save_name, c.category_path as category_path, p.status as status from product p left join stock s on p.product_id = s.product_id left join product_image i on p.image_id=i.image_id left join ( select category_id, ltrim(sys_connect_by_path(category_name,'>'),'>') as category_path from category start with parent_id is null connect by prior category_id = parent_id) c on p.category_id = c.category_id
(p.product_name like '%'||#{keyword}||'%' or c.category_path like '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
( p.status = #{status} )
order by p.product_id )
